items.title: MSCI-Entscheidung: Strategy und Metaplanet vor Index-Exklusion
items.summary: MSCI hat sich dazu entschieden, seinen Vorschlag zur Exklusion "nicht operativer Unternehmen" umzusetzen. Strategy und Metaplanet steht demnach eine Exklusion bevor.

items.title: MSCI finalizes index rules that put Strategy, crypto treasury firms at risk of exclusion
items.summary: MSCI's new non-operating company rules could exclude Strategy, Metaplanet and SharpLink. The final list of affected firms is due Nov. 11.

items.title: Russia Will Soon Ban Peer-to-Peer Bitcoin Trading, Central Bank Confirms
items.summary: Russians have until July 1, 2027 to buy and sell crypto directly with each other. After that, every trade runs through a broker or exchange approved by the Bank of Russia.

items.title: Bitcoin's Volatility Has Fallen Within S&P 500 Ranks, Study Shows
items.summary: Grayscale research shows that bitcoin's realized volatility is in the same range as a number of S&P 500 stocks. This post Bitcoin's Volatility Has Fallen Within S&P 500 Ranks, Study Shows first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Google gelingt Quanten-Durchbruch: Was bedeutet das jetzt für Bitcoin?
items.summary: Google überwindet eine wichtige Hürde bei Quantencomputern. Wie nah ist die Technologie wirklich daran, Bitcoins Kryptografie zu gefährden?

items.title: Google Touts 'Magic' Quantum Breakthrough as Bitcoin Q-Day Threat Looms
items.summary: Google has announced a major quantum computing breakthrough, demonstrating a technique that reduces errors by a factor of 40 and could help make powerful quantum computers more practical. The advance comes as researchers increasingly warn that future quantum machines could undermine the cryptography securing bitcoin and other…

items.title: Boom or Bust, Bitcoin Wins the AI Trade, Bitwise CIO Says
items.summary: In a note to investors, Matt Hougan used a "Choose Your Own Adventure" framework to argue that superabundance, an AI bust or a muddle-through economy all ultimately funnel to the same place: Bitcoin higher.

items.title: US Hoovers up Bitcoin While the World Runs on Its Digital Dollars: Report
items.summary: Chainalysis research shows that the U.S. is HODLing hard. This post US Hoovers up Bitcoin While the World Runs on Its Digital Dollars: Report first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: BlackRock's Larry Fink Warns AI Data Center Halt Could Tip US Into Recession
items.summary: Speaking after BlackRock's Q3 earnings, Fink said AI infrastructure spending has become so central to growth that a construction halt would be dangerous–calling the backlash "misinformation" as data centers become a midterm flashpoint.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Rebounds Above $82K After Brief Dip Below $80K
items.summary: Bitcoin staged a rapid recovery Thursday, climbing back above $82,000 to trade slightly higher over 24 hours with a market cap near $1.65 trillion.
